create_approval_request.details: All 6 types working: expense, leave_request, purchase_order, invoice, salary_change, document. Validates type, creates with proper structure including approvers and levels

get_pending_approvals.details: Returns pending approvals for current user based on their approval level

get_my_requests.details: Returns all requests created by current user. Status filter working

get_approval_stats.details: Returns my_pending, total_requests, by_status, by_type, average_approval_hours

get_workflows.details: Returns all workflow configurations with default approvers for each type

approve_request.details: Approves request at current level, moves to next level or marks fully approved

reject_request.details: Rejects request with reason, updates status to rejected

cancel_request.details: Allows requester to cancel their own pending requests

authorization.details: All endpoints require authentication. 401 returned without token

frontend_stats_cards.details: 4 stat cards: Awaiting My Approval, Total Requests, Approved, Avg Approval Time

frontend_pending_tab.details: Shows pending approvals with Approve/Reject buttons. Request cards show title, type, description, amount, date, level

frontend_workflows_tab.details: Shows all 6 workflow types with their default approvers and Active badge
